title: Freelance Pitch Form
description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest.

While the vast majority of ProPublica ’s work comes from our staff, we occasionally consider supporting ambitious accountability stories or projects from independent journalists whose ideas align with the mission of our organization.

Here’s what journalists submitting proposals should know.

We’re open to investigations that are revelatory or substantially advance what is known on a subject of importance. The investigation should have the potential to trigger needed reforms by identifying a problem, who’s responsible and what should change. It should also clearly show harm. The investigation can be rooted in a place or focus on a person, but it should illuminate an issue of broader relevance.

The best proposals have a clear hypothesis, typically based on significant reporting: They don’t wonder whether something bad is happening, they know it. Please include not only a general description of the topic, but also a sense of the anecdotes/data/documents you have gathered, what you expect to find and possible accountability stories you want to tell.
In addition, applicants should detail, as much as is possible at the outset, what an investigation will require: data work, travel, obtaining public records. It’s also important for us to know what data, documents and/or source relationships the reporter already has. Finally, we’d like to hear a bit about why you are particularly suited to do this investigation.

We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, and aim to notify candidates regarding your proposals within two weeks of submission. Questions? Send an email to . No phone calls, please.
For those proposals we accept, we pay competitive freelance rates, including reporting expenses. Freelancers are independent contractors and will not be treated by ProPublica as employees for any purpose.

title: Senior Proposal Consultant
description:
Job Summary
The Senior Proposal Consultant brings federal acquisition fluency, proposal writing craft, proposal graphic design experience, and applied AI expertise to support our subject matter experts (SMEs) in developing winning healthcare proposals.
This is not a health SME position. A Senior Proposal Consultant who knows federal proposals well and can engage productively with health SMEs will succeed here without a public health degree.
Primary Responsibilities
The Senior Proposal Consultant interprets Section L instructions and Section M evaluation criteria for each pursuit. They advise the Solution Lead on the FAR and contract vehicle requirements (VHA IHT 2.0, NIH, broader HHS). When the team meets to devise the proposal strategy, the Senior Proposal Consultant contributes win themes, discriminators, and methods to connect the Solution Lead’s overall approach to the evaluation criteria clearly.
Proposal Development
As an AI tool specialist and innovator, the Proposal Consultant leads technical research gathering and drafts the bulk of the technical volume, working to support and implement the Solution Lead’s vision. The Consultant is not simply a technical writer; this role requires active thought partnership with the Solution Lead to develop innovative health solutions that satisfy all solicitation requirements and maximize value to the Government customer. Emphasis on Aptive ’s differentiators, evaluator-aligned framing, compelling graphics, and compliance review are among the Consultant’s key contributions. Graphics are developed collaboratively: the Senior Proposal Consultant converts the Solution Lead’s sketches and concepts (logic models, service delivery models, care pathways, journey maps, governance structures, evaluation frameworks) into production-ready proposal visuals, working closely with our graphic designers. The Consultant also coordinates with the pricing team to produce the bid’s staffing level of effort.
The Proposal Consultant applies AI context engineering expertise to perform virtually all tasks: assembling the right reference materials, customer knowledge, competitive intelligence, past performance examples, win themes, settled solution detail, and evaluation criteria so our LLMs produce color review-ready narrative.

Demonstrated capacity to draft full technical volumes when the Solution Lead has determined the solution.

• Familiarity with federal health programs sufficient to converse credibly with health SMEs across all Aptive pursuit categories, ask the right clarifying questions, and represent the solution accurately in writing. (A public health degree is not required.)

• Extremely strong writing, editing, and visual thinking. The ability to convert complex concepts into clean narrative and clear graphics under deadline pressure.

What You'll Do

Lead Engineering Delivery : Lead engineers day-to-day and partner closely with the VP of Engineering and fellow PMs to ship - balancing speed and rigor, and unblocking the team.
Partner with Technical BD: Work tightly with technical business development to sense where the market and customer needs are heading, and fold that signal into the roadmap. Know every relevant product in the market and how Boundless should be positioned against it.
Exercise Product Intuition: Make good, fast calls in ambiguous situations, and know when to gather more signal versus when to commit.
Requirements

• Product leadership experience at both an AI startup and a larger / non-startup company

• Deep knowledge of the AI infrastructure, compute, and inference product landscape - you know the players and the products

• Track record of owning roadmaps and shipping technical products end-to-end

• Strong customer-facing skills: discovery, prioritization, and working backwards

• Ability to lead engineers and collaborate effectively with a VP of Engineering and PM peers

• Strong product intuition, with comfort navigating ambiguity and a strong bias for action

• Technical enough to earn engineers' trust (working fluency in inference, RL, or GPU compute)

• 2-6 years of relevant product management experience.

• Proven experience building and launching products from 0-1.

• Background in ML/AI infrastructure, GPU compute, or distributed systems

• Experience with working-backwards / PR-FAQ product processes

• Prior IC engineering background

• Experience taking a technical platform or API product to market
